label: Insurer that published the price
plain_english_description: The insurance company / plan administrator that published the data. Here it is always Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Texas.

label: Type of reporting entity
plain_english_description: Whether the publisher is acting as a health insurance issuer (the insurer of a fully-insured plan) or a third-party administrator (the administrator of an employer's self-funded/ASO plan).

label: Provider network
plain_english_description: The named provider network the price applies to (for example Blue Choice PPO, Blue Essentials, Blue Advantage HMO). Prices are published per network.

label: Coverage segment served
plain_english_description: Which coverage segment the network serves: fully-insured, self-funded (ASO), or both. IMPORTANT: a negotiated price is published at the NETWORK level, not the segment level — the same network price is used by both fully-insured and self-funded plans, so most rows are 'both'.
source_mrf_field: (derived from which route/index referenced the file)

label: Monthly snapshot date
plain_english_description: The 'last updated' date stamped on the source file. This is the monthly snapshot the price belongs to; use it as the time dimension when stacking months.

label: Texas 2036 extraction date
plain_english_description: The date Texas 2036 downloaded and extracted this record. Lets you tell apart re-runs of the same monthly snapshot.

label: Source data-format version
plain_english_description: The CMS machine-readable-file format version of the source file. Guards against silent format changes month to month.

label: Source filename
plain_english_description: The filename of the source machine-readable file this price came from. Part of the key that links to the provider crosswalk.

label: Medical code system
plain_english_description: The medical coding system the procedure code belongs to. Different systems can reuse the same number, so this must be read together with procedure_code.

label: Code system version
plain_english_description: The version or edition (often a year) of the coding system, e.g. CPT 2026. Needed for clean year-over-year comparisons.

label: Procedure code
plain_english_description: The procedure, service, or item code being priced (for example CPT 27447 = total knee replacement).

label: Insurer's description
plain_english_description: The insurer's own free-text description of the service. Helpful for reading the data, but NOT standardized — do not group on it.

label: Texas 2036 short label
plain_english_description: A short, consistent label for the procedure, from the Texas 2036 service menu (config/target_codes.csv). Use this for readable tables.

label: Texas 2036 service group
plain_english_description: The Texas 2036 service grouping for the procedure (for example Imaging, Maternity, Inpatient stay). Use this for category-level breakdowns.
value_labels: Evaluation & management; Imaging; Lab; Maternity; Inpatient stay; etc.

label: Payment arrangement
plain_english_description: How the service is paid for: fee-for-service (a price per service), a bundle (one price covering several services), or capitation (a per-member payment). Only fee-for-service prices are directly comparable as unit prices.

label: How to read the amount
plain_english_description: How to interpret negotiated_amount: a plain negotiated dollar price; a fee-schedule amount; a percentage of billed charges; a per-diem (per-day) amount; or a derived amount. You MUST read this before using the amount.
value_labels: negotiated; fee schedule; percentage; per diem; derived

label: Negotiated price
plain_english_description: The negotiated price. U.S. dollars for every basis EXCEPT 'percentage', where it is a percent (for example 40.5 means 40.5% of billed charges).

label: Professional vs facility
plain_english_description: Whether the price is for a professional (clinician) service, an institutional (facility) service, or both. Professional and facility prices are different markets and should not be averaged together.

label: Care setting
plain_english_description: The care setting the price applies to.

label: Place-of-service code(s)
plain_english_description: One or more CMS place-of-service codes where the price applies (semicolon-separated). For example 11 = office, 21 = inpatient hospital, 23 = emergency room.

label: Procedure modifier(s)
plain_english_description: Any procedure-code modifiers attached to the price (semicolon-separated), e.g. a modifier marking the professional component of an imaging study.

label: Price expiration date
plain_english_description: The date the negotiated price expires.

label: No-expiration flag
plain_english_description: 1 = the price has no real expiration date (the source uses the placeholder 9999-12-31); 0 = it expires on rate_expiration.

label: Link to provider crosswalk
plain_english_description: A number that links this price to a set of providers. It is unique ONLY within source_file, so always join to the provider crosswalk on BOTH source_file AND provider_group_id.

label: Source filename
plain_english_description: The source file the provider group came from. Part of the key linking back to the rates table.

label: Provider-group number
plain_english_description: The provider-group number. Unique only within source_file. Join to the rates table on source_file + provider_group_id.

label: Texas NPIs in the group
plain_english_description: How many Texas NPIs (NPPES practice state = TX) are in this provider group. Individual NPI lists are not stored here (they explode the file); only the count is kept. For full NPI lists re-run with the optional per-NPI output.

label: Tax ID type
plain_english_description: The type of the provider group's tax identifier.

label: Tax ID number
plain_english_description: The provider group's tax identification number.

label: Organization name
plain_english_description: The organization / business name of the provider group (present when the tax ID is an employer ID number).

label: Network(s)
plain_english_description: The provider network(s) this group is listed under in the source file.

label: Provider network
plain_english_description: The named provider network.

label: Tax ID type
plain_english_description: ein = employer ID number; npi.

label: Tax ID number
plain_english_description: The organization's (or individual's) tax identification number.

label: Organization name
plain_english_description: Organization or individual name as filed by the insurer (raw and inconsistent; individual clinicians sometimes appear as their own tax ID).

label: Appearance count
plain_english_description: How many provider-group entries reference this tax ID in this network. An appearance count, NOT a clean provider headcount.

label: Source filename
plain_english_description: The prescription-drug source file this price came from.

label: Texas 2036 extraction date
plain_english_description: Date Texas 2036 extracted this record.

label: Insurer
plain_english_description: Insurer that published the price (BCBS Texas).

label: Reporting entity type
plain_english_description: e.g., health insurance issuer.

label: Drug name
plain_english_description: The drug name as published by the insurer.

label: Drug type
plain_english_description: Generic / brand / specialty grouping as published.

label: National Drug Code
plain_english_description: The National Drug Code identifying the drug product.

label: Negotiated drug price
plain_english_description: The negotiated price for the drug (US$).

label: Dispensing fee
plain_english_description: Pharmacy dispensing fee (US$).

label: Administrative fee
plain_english_description: Administrative fee (US$).

label: Transaction fee
plain_english_description: Transaction fee (US$).

label: Historical net price
plain_english_description: Historical net price reported for the drug (US$).

label: Pharmacy service code
plain_english_description: Pharmacy service/setting code (e.g., retail, mail order).

label: Collapsed price records
plain_english_description: How many raw price records collapsed into this distinct drug-price row.

label: Distinct pharmacy tax IDs
plain_english_description: Distinct pharmacy-group tax IDs paid this drug price.

label: Pharmacy-ID memberships
plain_english_description: Pharmacy-ID memberships paid this price (breadth; double-counts across groups).
